us-r0.name: USA, first pressing
us-r0.title: Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee
us-r0.note: The levels as first pressed, before Rev 1 revised them: a few collision lines and 28 objects set otherwise, the Scrabania map and a Paramonia screen as first drawn, and the background Glukkons and chanting Mudokons as first animated.

us-r1.name: USA, Rev 1
us-r1.title: Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee
us-r1.note: Rev 2's levels and screens, without the two Exoddus promo screens on its menu.

eu.name: Europe
eu.title: Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee
eu.note: Hundreds of collision lines and dozens of objects reworked, a few screens and foregrounds redrawn, and 25 frames a second.

fr.name: France
fr.title: Oddworld: L'Odyssée d'Abe
fr.note: French text on the signs and screens, over the levels as first pressed, before Rev 1 revised them, and 25 frames a second.

de.name: Germany
de.title: Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee

it.name: Italy
it.title: Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee

es.name: Spain

jp.name: Japan
jp.title: Abe a GoGo
jp.note: Japanese text on the signs and screens and the hand prints on the stones redrawn, over Rev 2's levels.

eu.name: Europe
eu.title: Oddworld: Abe's Exoddus
eu.note: The same levels as the North American release, at 25 frames a second. The gas countdowns still count frames by 30, so one of 7200 frames shows 240 seconds and lasts 288.
